extensionName.description: Shown in the browser's extension list and on the store page.

extensionDescription.message: AI chat and ask-on-select on any web page. Works with OpenAI-compatible endpoints; the key stays in this browser.

toggleSelectionShortcut.message: Toggle between instant questions and the selection button

optionsIntro.message: These settings apply to the whole browser. Requests go straight from the browser to the endpoint you enter. The key is kept only in this browser (browser.storage.local) and never goes through a relay.
